lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoot sach bhai rate jot sachee man maahi ||
lines.translation: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak augan veesare gur raakhe pat taahi ||4||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak beRee sach kee tareeai gur veechaar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaavahee poor bhare aha(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: manahath matee boodeeai guramukh sach s taar ||1||
lines.translation: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin kiu tareeai sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh too mai avar na doojaa koi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai dekhau dau jalai paachhai hario a(n)goor ||
lines.translation: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis te upajai tis te binasai ghat ghat sach bharapoor ||
lines.translation: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel milaavahee saachai mahal hadoor ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahi saahi tujh sa(n)malaa kade na visaareu ||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu saahab man vasai guramukh a(n)mrit peu ||
lines.translation: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man tan teraa too dhanee garab nivaar sameu ||3||
lines.translation: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ehu jagat upaaiaa tribhavan kar aakaar ||
lines.translation: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh chaanan jaaneeai manamukh mugadh gubaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat jot nira(n)taree boojhai guramat saar ||4||
lines.translation: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jinee jaaniaa tin keechai saabaas ||
lines.translation: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache setee ral mile sache gun paragaas ||
lines.translation: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa jeeu pi(n)d prabh paas ||5||16||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun man mitr piaariaa mil velaa hai eh ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag ihu tan deh ||
lines.translation: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavaee dhahi dheree tan kheh ||1||
lines.translation: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man lai laahaa ghar jaahi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam salaaheeai haumai nivaree bhaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun ga(n)dhan ga(n)dheeai likh paR bujhahi bhaar ||
lines.translation: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa ahinis agalee haumai rog vikaar ||
lines.translation: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ohu veparavaahu atolavaa guramat keemat saar ||2||
lines.translation: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh siaanap je karee lakh siu preet milaap ||
lines.translation: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sa(n)gat saadh na dhraapeeaa bin naavai dookh sa(n)taap ||
lines.translation: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har jap jeeare chhuteeai guramukh cheenai aap ||3||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man gur pahi vechiaa man deeaa sir naal ||
lines.translation: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tribhavan khoj dha(n)dholiaa guramukh khoj nihaal ||
lines.translation: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: satagur mel milaaiaa naanak so prabh naal ||4||17||
lines.translation: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: maranai kee chi(n)taa nahee jeevan kee nahee aas ||
lines.translation: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sarab jeeaa pratipaalahee lekhai saas giraas ||
lines.translation: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar guramukh too vasahi jiu bhaavai tiu nirajaas ||1||
lines.translation: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeare raam japat man maan ||
lines.translation: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar laagee jal bujhee paaiaa guramukh giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
